All Roads to Peace#439.dst: 次のページでは、イチョウの葉が脳の絵を指しており、似たような矢印が眉をひそめたオークから笑っているオークへ向かっている。

All Roads to Peace#440.src: So that means it's good for mood and mental health...and that it does something with bleeding, but you can't tell whether it would be good or bad for it.
All Roads to Peace#440.dst: つまり気分と心の健康にはいいということで…そして出血にも何か関わるが、よいのか悪いのかは読み取れない。

All Roads to Peace#441.src: The book depicts red-orange flowering stalks, almost like cattails.
All Roads to Peace#441.dst: 本には赤橙色の花穂が描かれていて、まるでガマのようだ。

All Roads to Peace#442.src: There's a large illustration of an orc with big purple blotches all over it, and next to it there's a similar illustration with orange splotches instead.
All Roads to Peace#442.dst: 全身に大きな紫の斑点があるオークの大きな挿絵があり、その隣には斑点が橙色になった似た絵がある。

All Roads to Peace#443.src: That implies that ground-up pyrola goes on there...probably depicting bruises.
All Roads to Peace#443.dst: すりつぶしたイチヤクソウをそこに塗るらしい…描かれているのはおそらく打ち身だ。

All Roads to Peace#444.src: Similar orange splotches are shown applied to what is clearly a cut, and the next illustration over shows the same cut having become smaller.
All Roads to Peace#444.dst: 似たような橙色の斑点が、明らかに切り傷に塗られていて、その次の絵では同じ傷が小さくなっている。

All Roads to Peace#445.src: Then there's illustrations of what look like...veins? There's a lot of orcish script next to it, so you can't make heads or tails of what that much could mean.
All Roads to Peace#445.dst: さらに…血管らしきものの絵がある？そのそばにオークの文字がびっしり書かれているので、それが何を意味するのかはまったく見当がつかない。

All Roads to Peace#446.src: The book depicts a short shrub covered in vibrant red berries on small stalks.
All Roads to Peace#446.dst: 本には細い茎に鮮やかな赤い実をびっしりつけた低い低木が描かれている。

All Roads to Peace#447.src: There are multiple illustrations of what look like sick orcs- sneezing and coughing shown in pictures.
All Roads to Peace#447.dst: 病気らしいオークの挿絵がいくつもある――くしゃみと咳が絵で示されている。

All Roads to Peace#448.src: One illustration shows what looks to be an orc in great pain, and arrows pointing from the elderberries to those figures.
All Roads to Peace#448.dst: ある挿絵にはひどく痛がっているらしいオークが描かれ、ニワトコの実からそれらの姿へ矢印が向かっている。

All Roads to Peace#449.src: Your best guess is that elderberries are good for healing mild illnesses, and maybe for dulling pain.
All Roads to Peace#449.dst: せいぜい推測できるのは、ニワトコの実が軽い病気を治すのによく、痛みを和らげるのにも使えるかもしれないということだ。

All Roads to Peace#450.src: The balm doesn't seem to have worked this time either. He's still bleeding badly. Maybe you can just...cover up all the cuts and hope for the best? Or maybe that's not a good idea.
All Roads to Peace#450.dst: 今回も軟膏は効かなかったようだ。まだひどく出血している。もう傷を全部ふさいで、うまくいくよう願うだけか？いや、それはいい考えではないかもしれない。

All Roads to Peace#451.src: Still no significant effect. The orc's breathing is getting shallower...
All Roads to Peace#451.dst: やはり目立った効果はない。あのオークの息はどんどん浅くなっている……

All Roads to Peace#452.src: ... Agreed. We should get back to our tasks though.
All Roads to Peace#452.dst: 同感だ。だが、そろそろ持ち場に戻ったほうがいい。
All Roads to Peace#452.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#453.src: If she's worried about you just following orders, then if you go and help out some orcs on your own, Ureietun might change her mind.
All Roads to Peace#453.dst: 君が命令に従っているだけだと彼女が気にしているなら、自分から進んでオークを助けに行けば、Ureietun も考えを変えるかもしれない。

All Roads to Peace#454.src: There are lots of orcs around. Asking them if they need help should be simple enough.
All Roads to Peace#454.dst: まわりにはオークがたくさんいる。手伝いが必要か聞いてみるくらいは簡単だろう。

All Roads to Peace#455.src: Human stupid? I say no see Arrai-Veretel!
All Roads to Peace#455.dst: 人間、馬鹿か？Arrai-Veretel に会えない、言った！

All Roads to Peace#456.src: Suppose that's that, then- Fruludir has his package. Time to go back to Peloros.
All Roads to Peace#456.dst: これで終わりだ――Fruludir は荷物を受け取った。Peloros のところへ戻る時間だ。

All Roads to Peace#457.src: Peloros train hard. Peloros work hard. Peloros work everyone hard, do everything hard.
All Roads to Peace#457.dst: Peloros 厳しく鍛える。Peloros 厳しく働く。Peloros みんなを厳しく働かせる、何でも厳しくやる。

All Roads to Peace#458.src: Heard that Peloros thinking of making more race spot.
All Roads to Peace#458.dst: Peloros、競走の場所もっと作ろうと考えていると聞いた。

All Roads to Peace#459.src: Maybe if war stop, then all orc can try run. Maybe human try run too.
All Roads to Peace#459.dst: 戦争止まれば、オークみんな走ってみられるかも。人間も走ってみるかも。

All Roads to Peace#460.src: NO! Wrong! Say wrong, all wrong! Sound even stupider than normal!
All Roads to Peace#460.dst: 違う！間違い！間違って言った、全部間違い！いつもよりもっと馬鹿に聞こえる！
All Roads to Peace#460.speaker: Xoeinbor

All Roads to Peace#461.src: Want human try again! Feel pain of good name in stupid language! SAY NAME!
All Roads to Peace#461.dst: 人間もう一度やれ！いい名前を馬鹿な言葉で言われる痛み感じろ！名前言え！

All Roads to Peace#462.src: Supposed to learn human language for peace. Show orc good because big-nose grub say bad.
All Roads to Peace#462.dst: 和平のため人間の言葉を学ぶことになっている。大鼻の幼虫がオークは悪いと言うから、オークがいいと見せる。

All Roads to Peace#463.src: Idiot villager get human before orc, so human greet orc with weapon and death!
All Roads to Peace#463.dst: 馬鹿な村人がオークより先に人間をつかんだ、だから人間は武器と死でオークに挨拶！

All Roads to Peace#464.src: Now learn language but only in half, and name all stupid!
All Roads to Peace#464.dst: 今は言葉を半分だけ学ぶ、名前は全部馬鹿！

All Roads to Peace#465.src: His breathing is steady...better let him sleep.
All Roads to Peace#465.dst: 息は安定している…寝かせておいたほうがいいだろう。

All Roads to Peace#466.src: Just need [{~} Carp Meat] from human. Could bring more if wanted, but will not force you.
All Roads to Peace#466.dst: 人間から [{~} Carp Meat] だけいる。欲しければもっと持ってきてもいい、でも無理強いしない。

All Roads to Peace#467.src: All must work together to survive on earth. All have places, all have paths.
All Roads to Peace#467.dst: 大地で生き延びるには、みんな一緒に働く。みんな場所ある、みんな道ある。

All Roads to Peace#468.src: Many just take and not give. Villager, bugs, other human... You are different.
All Roads to Peace#468.dst: 多くは取るだけで与えない。村人、虫、ほかの人間…お前は違う。

All Roads to Peace#469.src: Still not understand why helping so much. It good, but was not expecting from human.
All Roads to Peace#469.dst: なぜそんなに助けるのか、まだわからない。いいことだ、でも人間からは期待していなかった。

All Roads to Peace#470.src: Can say, happy to be wrong about this.
All Roads to Peace#470.dst: 言える、間違っていてうれしい。

All Roads to Peace#471.src: Well, it seems like just trying to lift it won't work. Maybe casting some spells at it will dislodge it? Try casting multiple spells in a row.
All Roads to Peace#471.dst: どうやら、ただ持ち上げようとしてもだめらしい。呪文をいくつか当てればずらせるだろうか？呪文を続けて何発か撃ってみよう。

All Roads to Peace#472.src: Human! Try move rock, use magic!
All Roads to Peace#472.dst: 人間！岩動かしてみろ、魔法使え！
All Roads to Peace#472.speaker: Yunelsu

All Roads to Peace#473.src: Human can't find iron? There some in valley east of villager quarry, around villager with weapons.
All Roads to Peace#473.dst: 人間、鉄が見つからない？村人の石切り場の東の谷にいくつかある、武器持った村人のあたり。

All Roads to Peace#474.src: Maybe someplace closer. If so, not know where. Need [{~} Iron Ingots] total though.
All Roads to Peace#474.dst: もっと近い場所あるかも。あるなら、どこか知らない。でも全部で [{~} Iron Ingots] いる。

All Roads to Peace#475.src: Who is the fool who steps into this accursed cage?
All Roads to Peace#475.dst: この呪われた檻に踏み込む愚か者は誰だ？

All Roads to Peace#476.src: You are not of the old empire... Not one of those who forced me in here.
All Roads to Peace#476.dst: お前は旧帝国の者ではない……私をここに押し込めた者たちの一人でもない。

All Roads to Peace#477.src: Why do you take arms against me? I only tried to save my people from my father!
All Roads to Peace#477.dst: なぜ私に武器を取る？私は父から民を救おうとしただけだ！

All Roads to Peace#478.src: If you insist on ending me, then I'll dispose of you like I did that wretched emperor!
All Roads to Peace#478.dst: どうしても私を終わらせるというなら、あの忌まわしい皇帝と同じように始末してやる！

All Roads to Peace#479.src: Grrmb. Dumb Kreimu. Stupid Wynn language...Gavel language...pfeh. Whatever language. Not orc language.
All Roads to Peace#479.dst: ぐむ。馬鹿 Kreimu。馬鹿な Wynn の言葉…Gavel の言葉、ふん。どの言葉でも、オーク語じゃない。
All Roads to Peace#479.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#480.src: Not just that- Learning to be medicine orc. She medicine orc too! Healer, brewer, herbalist, whatever. Too much same!
All Roads to Peace#480.dst: それだけじゃない―薬のオークになる修行中。あいつも薬のオーク！治療師、薬師、薬草師、何でも。同じすぎ！
All Roads to Peace#480.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#481.src: Angry about it. Been distracting from training too. Human want help like help with Ressinter? Get Creinu- Crei...nu...not Kreimu...ingredient for medicine.
All Roads to Peace#481.dst: それで腹立つ。修行の邪魔にもなってる。Ressinter みたいに助けたい？Creinu に―Crei…nu…Kreimu じゃない、薬の材料取ってこい。
All Roads to Peace#481.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#482.src: [{~} Leafy Stalk]. Need to learn how to make much medicine out of little herb. Easy?
All Roads to Peace#482.dst: [{~} Leafy Stalks]。少ない草でたくさん薬作る方法、学ばないと。簡単だろ？
All Roads to Peace#482.speaker: Creinu

All Roads to Peace#483.src: [{~}/{~}] Onluk [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?
All Roads to Peace#483.dst: [{~1}/{~2}] Onluk [{~3} Willow Planks] あれば塔よくできる、たぶん。柳は強い木！持ってこられる？
All Roads to Peace#483.speaker: Onluk

similar.text: [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?

All Roads to Peace#484.src: Human welcome in Onluk tower two, but Onluk tower one better. Not safe to be on without fix tower though.
All Roads to Peace#484.dst: 人間、Onluk の塔二番は歓迎、でも Onluk の塔一番のほうがいい。でも塔直さないと上は安全じゃない。

All Roads to Peace#485.src: If want go on Onluk tower one, bring [{~} Willow Planks] so Onluk can fix!
All Roads to Peace#485.dst: [{~} Willow Planks] 持ってこい、Onluk が塔一番を直す！

All Roads to Peace#486.src: If bring up lots of arrow, maybe can shoot Freelancer. Like to run through sky. Cause problem for everyone, and Freelancer never actually die, just dissipate.
All Roads to Peace#486.dst: 矢たくさん持って上がれば、Freelancer を撃てるかも。空を走るのが好き。みんなに迷惑かける、しかも Freelancer は本当に死なない、消えるだけ。

All Roads to Peace#487.src: Fun time sometimes! Though sometimes Freelancer shoot back. That how Onluk tower one broke.
All Roads to Peace#487.dst: ときどき楽しい時間！でもときどき Freelancer が撃ち返す。Onluk の塔一番はそれで壊れた。

All Roads to Peace#488.src: Must be some reason. Not sure if tired of fighting or some other reason, but if human feel like helping, can use some help.
All Roads to Peace#488.dst: 何か理由あるはず。戦いに疲れたか、他の理由か知らない、でも人間手伝いたいなら、手を借りたい。
All Roads to Peace#488.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#489.src: Running low on blue dyes. Have plenty of the other colors, but need blue. Know where to get them, too.
All Roads to Peace#489.dst: 青い染料少なくなってる。他の色たくさんある、でも青いる。どこで取れるかも知ってる。
All Roads to Peace#489.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#490.src: Can't find the cave? Is outside the villager bridge, with the pond and arch by it.
All Roads to Peace#490.dst: 洞窟が見つからない？村人の橋の外、そばに池とアーチがあるところ。

All Roads to Peace#491.src: Get [{~} Terramarine Buds] so can make more dyes. Bright blue flowers, very dusty.
All Roads to Peace#491.dst: [{~} Terramarine Buds] 取ってくれば、染料もっと作れる。明るい青い花、とても粉っぽい。

All Roads to Peace#492.src: You unlearn villager stupidity, maybe? In the middle of unlearning? Perhaps a sign from the earth things will heal. Perhaps not. We will see.
All Roads to Peace#492.dst: 村人の愚かさ忘れようとしてる？忘れてる途中？大地が、傷癒える兆し見せてるのかも。違うかも。いずれわかる。
All Roads to Peace#492.speaker: Miliyus

All Roads to Peace#493.src: Mhm. Good! Sweetgale pulp make bugs avoid. Also make irritated skin soothe. Very good for bug bite.
All Roads to Peace#493.dst: うむ。いい！ヤチヤナギの汁、虫よける。荒れた肌も落ち着かせる。虫刺されにすごくいい。
All Roads to Peace#493.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#494.src: Broken weapon parts not good alone, but still sharp. Can be used to make other weapons! Reuse good for earth- waste not!
All Roads to Peace#494.dst: 壊れた武器の部品、それだけだとだめ、でもまだ鋭い。他のいい武器作るのに使える！再利用、大地にいい―無駄なし！
All Roads to Peace#494.speaker: Etemitoro

All Roads to Peace#495.src: What in the... HEY! Why's one of those big, scary humans in here?! Nunny, I thought you said we were gonna play a game!
All Roads to Peace#495.dst: なにこれ…ちょっと！なんででっかくて怖い人間がここにいるの？！Nunny、ゲームするって言ったじゃん！

All Roads to Peace#496.src: We are. This human isn't actually so bad. Care to introduce yourselves?
All Roads to Peace#496.dst: するさ。この人間は実はそう悪くない。自己紹介したらどうだ？
All Roads to Peace#496.speaker: Nunexetor

All Roads to Peace#497.src: Silly little goblins. Who goes and names themself after fruits?
All Roads to Peace#497.dst: おバカな小さいゴブリンたち。わざわざ果物の名前を自分につける者がいるかね？

All Roads to Peace#498.src: Guess goblins are just sort of fickle like that. But again, you just have to find all four of them.
All Roads to Peace#498.dst: ゴブリンというのはそういう気まぐれなものなのだろうね。とはいえ、四匹全部を見つけるしかない。

All Roads to Peace#499.src: None of them will have left the fortress, so it shouldn't take too long.
All Roads to Peace#499.dst: どのゴブリンも砦からは出ていないから、そう長くはかからないはずだ。

All Roads to Peace#500.src: I hear most humans are bullies. It's why Veltu over at the Trunkstump camp was training us to be tougher.
All Roads to Peace#500.dst: 人間ってほとんどいじめっ子なんだって。だから Trunkstump 野営地の Veltu が、あたしたちを鍛えてくれてたの。
All Roads to Peace#500.speaker: Grapes

All Roads to Peace#501.src: I lost, so I don't care about the game anymore. I saw Blueberry over by that one orc who keeps trying to lift that rock.
All Roads to Peace#501.dst: ぼく負けたから、もうこの遊びはどうでもいい。あの岩を持ち上げようとしてるオークのそばで Blueberry を見たよ。

All Roads to Peace#502.src: Ack! I saw Grapes on the hanging flag! Don't hurt me!
All Roads to Peace#502.dst: ぎゃっ！Grapes があの吊ってある旗の上にいるの見た！ぶたないで！

All Roads to Peace#503.src: Y'know, I probably shouldn't tell you this, but I could actually see Mango over in the other tower! She probably figured it was tough to get to.
All Roads to Peace#503.dst: ねえ、これ言っちゃいけないと思うけど、Mango があっちの塔の上にいるのが実は見えるんだ！上るのが大変だと思ったんだろうね。

All Roads to Peace#504.src: Uh... I wonder where Peaches went? I know he loves playing in the creeks at Waterway, so... Oh. I shouldn't spoil their spot.
All Roads to Peace#504.dst: えっと…Peaches はどこ行ったんだろう？Waterway の小川で遊ぶのが大好きなのは知ってるから、だから…あ。隠れ場所をばらしちゃだめだ。

All Roads to Peace#505.src: Yeah, I guess it wasn't as boring as I thought.
All Roads to Peace#505.dst: うん、思ったほど退屈じゃなかったかな。
All Roads to Peace#505.speaker: Mango

All Roads to Peace#507.src: Not much else to say. Was fun, I suppose.
All Roads to Peace#507.dst: ほかに言うことはあまりない。まあ、楽しかったよ。

All Roads to Peace#508.src: Hey! Human! Human who hunt spineback boar and help heal healer!
All Roads to Peace#508.dst: おい！トゲ背イノシシ狩って、治療師治すの手伝った人間！
All Roads to Peace#508.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#509.src: Not stupid human who go around kill other orc! Good human! Can trust. So trust, will ask for small thing.
All Roads to Peace#509.dst: オーク殺して回る馬鹿人間じゃない！いい人間！信じられる。だから、小さい頼みある。
All Roads to Peace#509.speaker: Teiren

All Roads to Peace#510.src: Oh, human forget. Teiren tell again! Southeast of fort, past ridge, Teiren old camp.
All Roads to Peace#510.dst: ああ、人間忘れた。Teiren もう一度言う！砦の南東、尾根の向こう、Teiren の古い野営地。

All Roads to Peace#511.src: Forgot important thing there. Need make sure Peloros no run into firepit. So, you go get!
All Roads to Peace#511.dst: 大事なもの、そこに忘れた。Peloros が火の穴に突っ込まないようにしないといけない。だから、お前が取ってこい！

All Roads to Peace#512.src: Lady, everything the wind touches is OURS! Not ta mention we're so close to the mountains we live on! This camp's our property, and that thing you got's part of the camp!
All Roads to Peace#512.dst: 嬢ちゃん、風が触れるモンは全部オレらのモンだ！しかもオレらの住む山はすぐそこだぜ！この野営地はオレらの財産、お前が持ってるそいつもその一部だ！
All Roads to Peace#512.speaker: Freelancer

All Roads to Peace#513.src: One so brazen as yourself could never share in the bounties of nature! Now begone, and leave me be!
All Roads to Peace#513.dst: あなたのような厚かましい者に、自然の恵みを分かち合う資格はありません！さあ去りなさい！放っておいて！
All Roads to Peace#513.speaker: Alraune

All Roads to Peace#514.src: Will say, got thing from Earthpit. Was brought by Holehold gofer during party.
All Roads to Peace#514.dst: 言う、ものは Earthpit から来た。宴のとき Holehold の使い走りが持ってきた。

All Roads to Peace#515.src: Special thing! Kept for long time. Important, so was bad to forget.
All Roads to Peace#515.dst: 特別なもの！長いあいだ取っておいた。大事だから、忘れたのは悪いこと。

All Roads to Peace#516.src: Will maybe invite human to next party!
All Roads to Peace#516.dst: 次の宴、人間を招くかも！

All Roads to Peace#517.src: Earth say what earth should be. Only need to listen to her.
All Roads to Peace#517.dst: 大地が大地のあるべき姿を言う。彼女の声を聞くだけでいい。

All Roads to Peace#518.src: Earth say rock should stay here, then rock stays here. Simple.
All Roads to Peace#518.dst: 大地が岩はここにいるべきと言うなら、岩はここにいる。簡単。

All Roads to Peace#519.src: Hurts, seeing earth rot in north. Big-nose grubs should feel her pain too- they make earth sick!
All Roads to Peace#519.dst: 北で大地が腐っていくのを見るのは痛い。大鼻の幼虫たちも彼女の痛みを感じるべきだ――大地を病ませているのは奴らだ！

All Roads to Peace#520.src: How can Zuett say human trying end war, when human START WAR AGAIN?!
All Roads to Peace#520.dst: 人間また戦争始めたのに、なぜ Zuett は人間が戦争終わらせようとしてる言える？！
All Roads to Peace#520.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#521.src: THAT. IS. THE. POINT!! Villager get human to fight for them! Cease-fire say Villager not attack orc. Then, human come over ocean. Try make peace- get attack!
All Roads to Peace#521.dst: それが。言いたい。こと！！村人、人間に代わりに戦わせる！停戦、村人オーク襲わない言う。そこへ人間海渡って来る。和平しようとした―襲われた！
All Roads to Peace#521.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#522.src: See human attack. Villager get human to attack, say lies to trick humans. Orcs defend self. Then, three Rai-orc die at Earthpit, Cliffhearth, Trunkstump goblin camp.
All Roads to Peace#522.dst: 人間襲うの見た。村人が人間に襲わせる、嘘で人間騙す。オーク身を守る。そして Rai のオーク三人、Earthpit、Cliffhearth、Trunkstump のゴブリン野営地で死んだ。
All Roads to Peace#522.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#523.src: Orc take human fort built in dying earth forest. Cannot know if human planning another attack! But not kill human. Hold human instead.
All Roads to Peace#523.dst: オーク、死にゆく大地の森に人間建てた砦取った。人間また襲う計画してるかわからない！でも人間殺さない。捕まえておく。
All Roads to Peace#523.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#524.src: War only killing us! If tried talk to human instead of go to sharpen spear and fight back, maybe human would learned faster than now.
All Roads to Peace#524.dst: 戦争、我ら殺すだけ！槍研いで反撃する代わりに人間と話そうとしてたら、人間もっと早く学んでたかも。
All Roads to Peace#524.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#525.src: Listen. Zuett. I want war stop too. But you must understand the risk here. Cannot make decision lightly. Villager go back on word- see writing, find way around writing.
All Roads to Peace#525.dst: 聞け、Zuett。私も戦争止めたい。でもここの危険わかれ。軽く決められない。村人約束破る―書いた物見て、抜け道探す。
All Roads to Peace#525.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#526.src: ...that right. Prepare, human. Arrai-Veretel strongest orc. Strong in everything. Mind, body, power, spirit.
All Roads to Peace#526.dst: ……そのとおり。備えろ、人間。Arrai-Veretel は最強のオーク。何でも強い。頭、体、力、精神。
All Roads to Peace#526.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#527.src: Zuett still think human trying to be good. Still think can help stupid war end. Knock sense into Arrai-Veretel. Arena is down stairs.
All Roads to Peace#527.dst: Zuett、まだ人間いいことしようとしてる思う。まだ馬鹿な戦争終わらせる助けになる思う。Arrai-Veretel 目覚めさせろ。
All Roads to Peace#527.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#528.src: Before fight... Must perform ritual. This challenge need respect. I do not respect you, human, but will show respect anyway.
All Roads to Peace#528.dst: 戦う前に…儀式やる。この挑戦、敬意いる。人間、お前尊重しない、でも敬意は示す。
All Roads to Peace#528.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#529.src: Hmh. Human probably trying end war to start with. Just on wrong side. Can agree, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#529.dst: フン。人間、たぶん最初から戦争終わらせたかった。ただ味方間違えた。賛成する、Zuett。
All Roads to Peace#529.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#530.src: Give opportunity for human to learn and villager to show respect. They not attack, then will be open to more negotiation.
All Roads to Peace#530.dst: 人間学ぶ機会、村人敬意示す機会やる。村人襲わなかったら、もっと交渉してもいい。
All Roads to Peace#530.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#531.src: Peace first step to heal. ...unless villager keep doing stupid thing. Then may need fight anyway.
All Roads to Peace#531.dst: 平和、癒しの第一歩。…村人が馬鹿なことしなければ。したら結局戦うかも。
All Roads to Peace#531.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#532.src: That's the cease-fire agreement! You need to hand this to Captain Goruca- He should be waiting in {p} still.
All Roads to Peace#532.dst: それが停戦協定だ！これを Goruca 隊長に渡してくれ――まだ {p} で待っているはずだ。

All Roads to Peace#533.src: Maybe see human again soon. Hopefully in good spirit and on good faith.
All Roads to Peace#533.dst: また人間に会えるかも。できればいい気持ちと誠意で。

All Roads to Peace#534.src: Go on. Give to whatever villager need to see it. Let them learn.
All Roads to Peace#534.dst: 行け。見る必要ある村人に渡せ。学ばせろ。

All Roads to Peace#535.src: ...Think new thoughts. Difficult ones, from now on.
All Roads to Peace#535.dst: ……新しい考えを考えろ。難しいのを、これからは。

All Roads to Peace#536.src: Keep thinking too. Not just copy what see. Figure for self what good and bad.
All Roads to Peace#536.dst: 考え続けろ。見たものを真似するだけじゃない。何がよくて何が悪いか自分で考えろ。

All Roads to Peace#537.src: After the way they so savagely attacked our outpost and the way they've rebuffed our diplomacy squads, I wasn't expecting this.
All Roads to Peace#537.dst: 前哨基地をあれほど野蛮に襲い、外交部隊を突っぱねた連中だ。こうなるとは思わなかった。
All Roads to Peace#537.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#538.src: You know, that one guy was going off about that orc catapult or whatever the entire time you were gone. He's shut up now, but criminy!
All Roads to Peace#538.dst: いやな、お前がいないあいだ、あの男がずっとオークのカタパルトだかなんだかについてまくし立てていたんだ。今は黙ったが、まったく！
